steps.ask: The formula is true for any $A$ and $B$. What choice of $A$ and $B$ gives the double angle $2\theta$?
steps.title: Start from the compound angle formula

lines.text: $\cos(A+B) = \cos A \cos B - \sin A \sin B$ is true for any angles, so we may choose $A = B = \theta$.

steps.ask: What are θ + θ, and what do the two products simplify to?
steps.title: Simplify both sides

lines.text: $\theta + \theta = 2\theta$, and the products are squares.
So $\hl{1}{\cos 2\theta} = \hl{2}{\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta}$, as required.
